from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    baseline = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)), None)\n    if baseline is None:\n        return out\n    heights = {2: 4, 8: 3}\n    for c, color in enumerate(grid[baseline]):\n        if color in heights:\n            for d in range(1, heights[color] + 1):\n                r = baseline - d\n                if r >= 0:\n                    out[r][c] = color if d == heights[color] else 1\n    return out\n'''
p=root/'task-97f687cf.py'
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
